blocks.content: Quiz: What is the main advantage of putting fetchEntries inside the Zustand store instead of inside a component?
Tap an option below to answer:
It makes the fetch run faster
Where the fetch lives does not affect how fast it runs.
Where the fetch lives does not affect how fast it runs.
Any component can trigger the fetch and any component can read the result without prop drilling
Correct! When fetchEntries lives in the store, any component can call it and any component can read entries, isLoading, or error — all without passing props.
Correct! When fetchEntries lives in the store, any component can call it and any component can read entries, isLoading, or error — all without passing props.
It removes the need for async/await
You still use async/await inside the store action. The store does not change how async code works.
You still use async/await inside the store action. The store does not change how async code works.
It prevents the component from re-rendering during the fetch
Components still re-render when store state changes. That is how they show the loading state.
Components still re-render when store state changes. That is how they show the loading state.
